remarks: Welcome to 27 Frontier Street, where privacy, comfort and an incredible entertainer’s backyard come together in one special home. Tucked away on a cul-de-sac along one of the highest streets in the neighborhood, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a wonderful combination of indoor-outdoor living, flexible spaces and exceptional privacy. Inside, the remodeled kitchen features updated cabinetry, countertops and backsplash, new flooring, a built-in pantry accented by a decorative barn door, and a center island complete with a wine refrigerator.
